channel.description: One actual source-owned AF_VSOCK connection to fixed Nitro parent CID3 port9102, acquired before the permanent serving identity drop. No inherited FD70 or caller-supplied socket identity. CID/port select transport only, not the receiving custody authority.

client.description: Explicit v3 client uses unchanged v2 stream framing and existing signed activation request/publication originals. The actual cold owner retains the same socket across privilege drop and narrows its original startup deadline once to the authenticated request expiry. One attempt, no retry/reconnect or timeout renewal. This supplies only the client resource; a genuine independently assigned v2 receiving service and durable journal remain required, and preboot closure is not enabled.
